pages.title: Neptune
pages.text: The farthest gas giant, with the fastest winds in the Solar System. You cannot land on it. Land on Triton with a tier 6 rocket. Proteus only stays on the map.

pages.title: Triton
pages.text: It orbits the planet backwards. Gravity is about 26% of Earth's. It is one of the coldest worlds, so bring the best thermal protection. It has large and small geysers. A geyser block is needed for the tier 6 oxygen tank.
